title: Validate the actual learned coded receiver with independent logical tests
statement: After counts-only calibration freezes each receiver, uniformly random six-state logical failure bits have mean (2/3)(1-F_e). The131072-shot holdout accepts at most52 failures; observed44 and48 pass F_e>=.999 for both fixed pipelines. The predeclared first passing pipeline is selected, protected by twelve simultaneous one-sided tests plus the sampling-TV debit. Exact source scores remain diagnostics.

evidence.quote: Five physical qubit channels independently apply unknown-axis amplitude damping followed by unknown fixed rotations. The source rates are approximately.00995–.01550. Generator/scorer code knows them to implement the physical experiment; the learner receives only ordinary six-state input/random-Pauli output counts. It fits the3-by-3 Bloch response, takes its proper orthogonal polar factor, and synthesizes an exactly rational SU2 frame through stereographic coordinates. Its inverse is a physical unitary on every record. No source parameter, protected reference or exact noise model enters the learner.

body: This is simulation with trusted stationary independent sources and ideal preparation, encoding, controls, readout and disposal, not hardware. Unencoded comparisons cover only the ten same-learned-inverse receivers, not all CPTP recovery or equal-rate resources. Two fresh private bits and trusted Pauli controls are required for the derived twirl, whose deployment was not executed. No generic continuing memory, source-bath bound, capacity or threshold follows. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
